verdict.rationale: Publishing on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments is a fair question for a global law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows publications on UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE or similar local instruments. The Book of Jargon entries cited are US-centric (409A, 83(b)), and the claim of presence in global hubs like London and Singapore shows office reach, not jurisdiction-specific founder content.
